data.one_liner: Customizable Flutter dropdown widget featuring search, highlighting, and smooth animations.
data.what_it_does: Provides a dropdown search widget supporting both single and multiple selection modes. It includes features like entry animations, text matching highlights, sorting selected items to the top, and scroll percentage indicators.
use_when: You need a dropdown selection widget that supports real-time text searching.
You require single or multiple selection modes with animated entry effects.
avoid_when: You need complex form builder integration or asynchronous server-side search loading which isn't documented.
You require an extremely lightweight native-looking platform dropdown.
strengths: Supports both single and multiple selection modes.
Built-in search functionality with matched text highlighting.
Smooth animations and cascading entry effects for dropdown items.
weaknesses: Limited to string data types based on the documentation.
Documentation lacks details on handling asynchronous data fetching.
